global_aesthetic: Futuristic Sci-Fi Adventure, Year 2248, Neo Cities with floating gardens and orbital transit gates, ancient ruins and underground vaults, anthropomorphic humanoid characters, cinematic wide establishing shots mixed with intimate character moments

characters.name: Theo Mensah

facial_blueprint.distinct_markers: Shell engraved with faint Cartographer sigils

characters.wardrobe_defaults: Signature clothing and accessories include systems engineer attire.

characters.name: Harrison Brooks
characters.wardrobe_defaults: Always wearing a racing helmet visor.

characters.name: Bella Alvarez
characters.wardrobe_defaults: Combat medic uniform with a glowing gold Life Crystal around the neck.

frames.narrative_action: Across four continents, four strangers simultaneously discover mysterious glowing Compass Fragments.
frames.visual_action: Aerial drone shot sweeping over Neo Accra's gleaming biodomes and engineered vines. The camera pans down to Theo Mensah in his systems engineer attire, standing in a lush garden. He holds a glowing Compass Fragment, his eyes wide with wonder.
frames.action_breakdown: Aerial drone shot sweeping over Neo Accra's gleaming biodomes and engineered vines. The camera pans down to Theo Mensah in his systems engineer attire, standing in a lush garden. He holds a glowing Compass Fragment, his eyes wide with wonder.
frames.lighting_notes: Bright sunlight filtering through biodomes, vibrant garden glow
frames.purpose: Establish the futuristic setting and introduce Theo's discovery
frames.director_notes: Set the stage for the discovery of the Compass Fragments, emphasizing the futuristic and mysterious atmosphere.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient city sounds, subtle electronic hum

frames.narrative_action: Each fragment projects the same holographic message: 'The Vault awakens. Seek Cairo.'
frames.visual_action: Close-up of the glowing Compass Fragment in Theo's hand. A holographic message projects from it, displaying the words 'The Vault awakens. Seek Cairo.'
frames.action_breakdown: Close-up of the glowing Compass Fragment in Theo's hand. A holographic message projects from it, displaying the words 'The Vault awakens. Seek Cairo.'
frames.lighting_notes: Holographic light casting a glow on Theo's face
frames.purpose: Highlight the importance of the message
frames.director_notes: Focus on the holographic message to build suspense and curiosity.
frames.sound_cue: Electronic hum of the holographic message

frames.narrative_action: Theo looks around, puzzled by the message.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of Theo looking around, his expression puzzled. The holographic message fades but the Compass Fragment continues to glow.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of Theo looking around, his expression puzzled. The holographic message fades but the Compass Fragment continues to glow.
frames.lighting_notes: Natural sunlight filtering through the garden
frames.purpose: Show Theo's reaction to the mysterious message
frames.director_notes: Capture Theo's initial confusion and curiosity.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient garden sounds

frames.narrative_action: Theo's discovery is mirrored in Neo Nairobi, Neo Mexico City, and Neo New York.
frames.visual_action: Quick cuts to Amina in Neo Nairobi, Bella in Neo Mexico City, and Harrison in Neo New York, each holding a glowing Compass Fragment and looking puzzled.
frames.action_breakdown: Quick cuts to Amina in Neo Nairobi, Bella in Neo Mexico City, and Harrison in Neo New York, each holding a glowing Compass Fragment and looking puzzled.
frames.lighting_notes: Varying natural and artificial lighting based on location
frames.purpose: Show the simultaneous discoveries across different locations
frames.director_notes: Use quick cuts to emphasize the simultaneous nature of the discoveries.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds from each location

frames.narrative_action: The four strangers meet for the first time beneath the Great Pyramid.
frames.visual_action: Establishing wide shot of the interior beneath the Great Pyramid, showing ancient stone foundations and glass-and-steel towers. The four strangers stand in a circle, each holding their Compass Fragment.
frames.action_breakdown: Establishing wide shot of the interior beneath the Great Pyramid, showing ancient stone foundations and glass-and-steel towers. The four strangers stand in a circle, each holding their Compass Fragment.
frames.lighting_notes: Natural light mixed with excavation zone spotlights
frames.purpose: Introduce the setting and the four strangers
frames.director_notes: Set the stage for the initial meeting and tension among the characters.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the excavation site

frames.narrative_action: Harrison mocks Theo.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of Harrison, his racing helmet visor reflecting the light. He smirks as he speaks to Theo.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of Harrison, his racing helmet visor reflecting the light. He smirks as he speaks to Theo.
frames.lighting_notes: Spotlights casting shadows on Harrison's face
frames.purpose: Show Harrison's dismissive attitude
frames.dialogue: You're going to slow us all down, tortoise.
frames.director_notes: Capture Harrison's arrogance and disdain.
frames.sound_cue: Harrison's voice, ambient excavation sounds

frames.narrative_action: Theo responds calmly.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of Theo, his broad-shouldered build and shell engraved with faint Cartographer sigils visible. He speaks quietly but firmly.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of Theo, his broad-shouldered build and shell engraved with faint Cartographer sigils visible. He speaks quietly but firmly.
frames.lighting_notes: Natural light illuminating Theo's face
frames.purpose: Show Theo's calm and composed demeanor
frames.director_notes: Contrast Theo's calmness with Harrison's arrogance.
frames.sound_cue: Theo's voice, ambient excavation sounds

frames.narrative_action: Amina expresses her skepticism.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of Amina, her sleek black fur and silver ear studs visible. She looks at the others with a skeptical expression.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of Amina, her sleek black fur and silver ear studs visible. She looks at the others with a skeptical expression.
frames.lighting_notes: Spotlights casting shadows on Amina's face
frames.purpose: Show Amina's skepticism and distrust
frames.dialogue: I'm not working with someone whose only skill is running away from problems.
frames.director_notes: Capture Amina's distrust and skepticism.
frames.sound_cue: Amina's voice, ambient excavation sounds

frames.narrative_action: Bella steps in to mediate.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of Bella, her graceful build and glowing gold Life Crystal visible. She steps between Theo and Harrison, her expression calm and reassuring.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of Bella, her graceful build and glowing gold Life Crystal visible. She steps between Theo and Harrison, her expression calm and reassuring.
frames.lighting_notes: Natural light illuminating Bella's face
frames.purpose: Show Bella's mediating role
frames.dialogue: We were all called here for a reason. Let's at least find out why.
frames.director_notes: Capture Bella's calm and reassuring demeanor.
frames.sound_cue: Bella's voice, ambient excavation sounds

frames.narrative_action: Amina cross-references the Compass Fragments.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of Amina using a holographic interface to cross-reference the Compass Fragments. The fragments glow as she works.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of Amina using a holographic interface to cross-reference the Compass Fragments. The fragments glow as she works.
frames.lighting_notes: Holographic light casting a glow on Amina's face
frames.purpose: Show Amina's investigative process
frames.dialogue: The fragments are linked. Four unique resonance signatures — one per person in this room. We descend from Cartographer guardians.
frames.director_notes: Capture Amina's focus and determination.
frames.sound_cue: Electronic hum of the holographic interface

frames.narrative_action: They discover the Atlas Codex.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of the group discovering the Atlas Codex beneath the pyramid floor. The Codex glows as it is revealed.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of the group discovering the Atlas Codex beneath the pyramid floor. The Codex glows as it is revealed.
frames.lighting_notes: Glowing light from the Atlas Codex
frames.purpose: Show the discovery of the Atlas Codex
frames.director_notes: Capture the group's excitement and discovery.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the excavation site

frames.narrative_action: Drones from the Obsidian Circle attack.
frames.visual_action: Wide shot of drones swarming into the chamber, their lights flashing. The group scrambles to escape through a hidden tunnel.
frames.action_breakdown: Wide shot of drones swarming into the chamber, their lights flashing. The group scrambles to escape through a hidden tunnel.
frames.lighting_notes: Flashing lights from the drones
frames.purpose: Show the sudden attack and chaos
frames.director_notes: Capture the sudden chaos and urgency of the attack.
frames.sound_cue: Drones' electronic hum, ambient sounds of chaos

frames.narrative_action: The team travels from Neo Cairo through Neo Rome.
frames.visual_action: Establishing wide shot of the team using an orbital transit gate to travel from Neo Cairo to Neo Rome. The gate's glow illuminates the scene.
frames.action_breakdown: Establishing wide shot of the team using an orbital transit gate to travel from Neo Cairo to Neo Rome. The gate's glow illuminates the scene.
frames.lighting_notes: Glowing light from the orbital transit gate
frames.purpose: Show the team's journey and the futuristic transit system
frames.director_notes: Capture the adventure and excitement of the journey.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the orbital transit gate

frames.narrative_action: The team arrives in Neo Rome.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of the team stepping out of the transit gate into Neo Rome. Renaissance marble and quantum-glass display panels surround them.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of the team stepping out of the transit gate into Neo Rome. Renaissance marble and quantum-glass display panels surround them.
frames.lighting_notes: Natural light mixed with digital display glow
frames.purpose: Show the team's arrival in Neo Rome
frames.director_notes: Capture the team's curiosity and excitement.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient city sounds

frames.narrative_action: The team travels into the Swiss Alps.
frames.visual_action: Wide shot of the team using another orbital transit gate to travel into the Swiss Alps. The gate's glow illuminates the scene.
frames.action_breakdown: Wide shot of the team using another orbital transit gate to travel into the Swiss Alps. The gate's glow illuminates the scene.
frames.lighting_notes: Glowing light from the orbital transit gate
frames.purpose: Show the team's journey into the Swiss Alps
frames.director_notes: Capture the adventure and excitement of the journey.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the orbital transit gate

frames.narrative_action: The team arrives in the Swiss Alps.
frames.visual_action: Establishing wide shot of the team arriving in the Swiss Alps. Suspended rail, floating plateaus, and snow peaks surround them.
frames.action_breakdown: Establishing wide shot of the team arriving in the Swiss Alps. Suspended rail, floating plateaus, and snow peaks surround them.
frames.lighting_notes: Natural daylight and cloud reflections
frames.purpose: Show the team's arrival in the Swiss Alps
frames.director_notes: Capture the team's awe and excitement.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the Swiss Alps

frames.narrative_action: The team enters a hidden Cartographer archive.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of the team entering a hidden Cartographer archive embedded in an Alpine cliff face. The archive's entrance glows with ancient sigils.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of the team entering a hidden Cartographer archive embedded in an Alpine cliff face. The archive's entrance glows with ancient sigils.
frames.lighting_notes: Glowing light from the archive's entrance
frames.purpose: Show the team's discovery of the archive
frames.director_notes: Capture the team's intrigue and curiosity.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the archive

frames.narrative_action: The team recovers the Chrono Hourglass.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of the team recovering the Chrono Hourglass. The Hourglass glows as it is revealed.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of the team recovering the Chrono Hourglass. The Hourglass glows as it is revealed.
frames.lighting_notes: Glowing light from the Chrono Hourglass
frames.purpose: Show the team's discovery of the Chrono Hourglass
frames.director_notes: Capture the team's excitement and discovery.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the archive

frames.narrative_action: The Chrono Hourglass activates, projecting visions.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of the Chrono Hourglass activating and projecting visions of the first guardians. The team watches in awe.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of the Chrono Hourglass activating and projecting visions of the first guardians. The team watches in awe.
frames.lighting_notes: Glowing light from the Chrono Hourglass
frames.purpose: Show the team's reaction to the visions
frames.director_notes: Capture the team's awe and wonder.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the archive, electronic hum of the Chrono Hourglass

frames.narrative_action: That evening, around a wooden table in a mountain village, tensions soften over a shared meal.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of the team sitting around a wooden table in a mountain village. They share a meal and converse calmly.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of the team sitting around a wooden table in a mountain village. They share a meal and converse calmly.
frames.lighting_notes: Soft lantern light
frames.purpose: Show the team's relaxation and bonding
frames.director_notes: Capture the team's relaxation and bonding.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the mountain village

frames.narrative_action: Bella and Theo have a quiet conversation.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of Bella and Theo having a quiet conversation. Bella smiles at Theo.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of Bella and Theo having a quiet conversation. Bella smiles at Theo.
frames.lighting_notes: Soft lantern light
frames.purpose: Show Bella and Theo's growing connection
frames.director_notes: Capture Bella and Theo's intimate moment.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the mountain village

frames.narrative_action: Harrison expresses his frustration.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of Harrison, his expression frustrated. He looks at the others with impatience.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of Harrison, his expression frustrated. He looks at the others with impatience.
frames.lighting_notes: Soft lantern light
frames.purpose: Show Harrison's frustration and impatience
frames.dialogue: We've wasted two days talking. We should already be at the next fragment.
frames.director_notes: Capture Harrison's frustration and impatience.
frames.sound_cue: Harrison's voice, ambient sounds of the mountain village

frames.narrative_action: Amina responds dryly.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of Amina, her expression dry. She looks at Harrison with a skeptical expression.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of Amina, her expression dry. She looks at Harrison with a skeptical expression.
frames.lighting_notes: Soft lantern light
frames.purpose: Show Amina's skepticism and dry response
frames.dialogue: You've never actually worked with a team before, have you?
frames.director_notes: Capture Amina's skepticism and dry response.
frames.sound_cue: Amina's voice, ambient sounds of the mountain village

frames.narrative_action: The team enters a sacred Cartographer sanctuary.
frames.visual_action: Establishing wide shot of the team entering a sacred Cartographer sanctuary preserved under a climate dome. Ancient bamboo sanctuaries and holographic shrine interfaces surround them.
frames.action_breakdown: Establishing wide shot of the team entering a sacred Cartographer sanctuary preserved under a climate dome. Ancient bamboo sanctuaries and holographic shrine interfaces surround them.
frames.lighting_notes: Soft lantern light and engineered silence
frames.purpose: Show the team's entry into the sanctuary
frames.director_notes: Capture the team's caution and tension.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the sanctuary

frames.narrative_action: The team faces mechanical traps and puzzles.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of the team facing mechanical traps and puzzles. The traps and puzzles activate, challenging the team.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of the team facing mechanical traps and puzzles. The traps and puzzles activate, challenging the team.
frames.lighting_notes: Soft lantern light
frames.purpose: Show the team's challenge and determination
frames.director_notes: Capture the team's determination and challenge.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the sanctuary, mechanical hum of the traps

frames.narrative_action: Amina explains the synchronization requirement.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of Amina explaining the synchronization requirement. The team listens intently.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of Amina explaining the synchronization requirement. The team listens intently.
frames.lighting_notes: Soft lantern light
frames.purpose: Show Amina's explanation and the team's focus
frames.dialogue: The synchronisation requires complete trust. One hesitation and the mechanism resets.
frames.director_notes: Capture Amina's focus and the team's attention.
frames.sound_cue: Amina's voice, ambient sounds of the sanctuary

frames.narrative_action: Harrison expresses his frustration.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of Harrison, his expression frustrated. He looks at the others with impatience.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of Harrison, his expression frustrated. He looks at the others with impatience.
frames.lighting_notes: Soft lantern light
frames.purpose: Show Harrison's frustration and impatience
frames.dialogue: This is insane. We barely know each other.
frames.director_notes: Capture Harrison's frustration and impatience.
frames.sound_cue: Harrison's voice, ambient sounds of the sanctuary

frames.narrative_action: Theo steps forward and speaks calmly.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of Theo stepping forward and speaking calmly. The team listens intently.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of Theo stepping forward and speaking calmly. The team listens intently.
frames.lighting_notes: Soft lantern light
frames.purpose: Show Theo's calm and composed demeanor
frames.dialogue: We don't need to know each other. We need to trust each other. Just this once.
frames.director_notes: Capture Theo's calmness and the team's attention.
frames.sound_cue: Theo's voice, ambient sounds of the sanctuary

frames.narrative_action: The four fragments glow and the vault door opens.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of the four fragments glowing and the vault door opening. The team watches in awe.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of the four fragments glowing and the vault door opening. The team watches in awe.
frames.lighting_notes: Glowing light from the fragments
frames.purpose: Show the team's reaction to the vault door opening
frames.director_notes: Capture the team's awe and wonder.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the sanctuary, electronic hum of the fragments

frames.narrative_action: A bridge section collapses beneath Bella's feet.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of a bridge section collapsing beneath Bella's feet. Theo throws himself forward and catches her.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of a bridge section collapsing beneath Bella's feet. Theo throws himself forward and catches her.
frames.lighting_notes: Soft lantern light
frames.purpose: Show the urgent and dramatic moment
frames.director_notes: Capture the urgency and drama of the moment.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the sanctuary, sound of the bridge collapsing

frames.narrative_action: The team is truly a team for the first time.
frames.visual_action: Medium shot of the team standing together, their expressions determined and united.
frames.action_breakdown: Medium shot of the team standing together, their expressions determined and united.
frames.lighting_notes: Soft lantern light
frames.purpose: Show the team's unity and determination
frames.director_notes: Capture the team's unity and determination.
frames.sound_cue: Ambient sounds of the sanctuary

NEO_NEW_YORK: cloud cover, vertical screens, hover-racing circuit (neon glow, atmospheric lighting)

NEO_ROME: Renaissance marble, quantum-glass display panels, underground archive networks (historical ambiance, digital display glow)
SWISS_SKY_RAILWAY: suspended rail, floating plateaus, snow peaks (natural daylight, cloud reflections)
NEO_KYOTO: ancient bamboo sanctuaries, climate domes, holographic shrine interfaces (soft lantern light, engineered silence)

Aesthetic: Futuristic Sci-Fi Adventure, Year 2248, Neo Cities with floating gardens and orbital transit gates, ancient ruins and underground vaults, anthropomorphic humanoid characters, cinematic wide establishing shots mixed with intimate character moments.

camera_language.dialogue: 50mm, OTS + medium, static or slow push
camera_language.establishing: 24mm anamorphic, wide, slow crane or drone

visual_rules: Global aesthetic: Futuristic Sci-Fi Adventure, Year 2248, Neo Cities with floating gardens and orbital transit gates, ancient ruins and underground vaults, anthropomorphic humanoid characters, cinematic wide establishing shots mixed with intimate character moments
Render style: flat_color — maintain consistency across all frames
Character appearance must match approved_characters on every generation
Do not introduce new character designs not present in the character bible
Identity layers (face, hair, eyes, markers) are immutable across variants
